neighbours.label: Several separate parties or roles each doing a part of a shared activity (interprofessional, non-parent, teachers and therapists together, each worker); its logit effect promotes 'shared, collaborative, joint'
fire: Pharmacists, midwives and dentists train side by side in this interprofessional programme.
Courts sometimes let non-custodial stepparents apply for contact with a child.
Architects, builders and suppliers worked from one shared plan on the site.
Each node trains on its own part of the data, then the peers exchange results.
Investors, creditors and tenants all took part in the bankruptcy talks.
Parents, counsellors and school staff must plan together for the pupil.
The two labs co-authored the study and pooled their samples.
Every volunteer handles a separate task, and the group meets to combine them.
quiet: Pharmacists sell cough syrup at this small shop near the bus station.
Courts sometimes close early on the Friday before a long weekend.
The builder poured the concrete and left it to dry on the site.
Each page prints on its own sheet of paper, then the machine stops.
The tenant paid the rent and moved out of the apartment in June.
The pupil packed a bag and walked to school in the rain.
The lab bought a new freezer and stored its samples.
Every morning the old man feeds the ducks and walks back home.

notes: The output direction promotes shared, collaborative, joint on this pole. Probes read 0.20-0.46; the peak token varies.
